The Router was not too lenient; the visible features do match the grey whale characteristics. The Router's severity ratings seem appropriate, but I would slightly increase the water-whale boundary artifact to 2.0 due to the slightly unnatural foam pattern and the perfect smoothness of the skin-water transition in some areas.
